ModMetaData.name: Jawa Armoury Rebalance
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Restretches the weapon ladder so the armoury matches the setting's physical laws instead of RimWorld's defaults.
The problem it fixes, measured on this exact mod set: the median ranged weapon did 12 damage and the median BLASTER did 10 — against a human fist at 8.2. Four in five weapons needed three or more hits to drop an unarmoured person, a wooden club outperformed a blaster rifle, and a turbolaser did 80, only 1.45x a vanilla sniper turret. Everything from fist to capital battery lived inside a 10x range.
What changes: standard blaster -> 24-34 1-2 shots unarmoured, ~5 vs advanced armour heavy blaster -> 52-72 deliberately breaks the 5-shot contract slugthrower -> 18-36 spread wide; the answer to desert megafauna vibro -> 35-52 the anti-ablative counter lightsaber -> 80-120 supreme vs flesh (and useless vs vehicle plate) turbolaser -> 800-2000 two orders above personal weapons
What deliberately does NOT change: ion, stun, EMP, sonic and disruptor weapons keep their near-zero damage. The verb IS the weapon — an ion gun that kills is just a worse blaster. Explosives are untouched too: blast has no hard counter, so it is balanced by scarcity alone.
Relative ordering inside every weapon family is preserved — this restretches the ladder, it does not flatten it.
Rationale: worldbuilding/setting_physics.md (the 18 laws) and worldbuilding/balance_paradigm.md (why we change any value at all). Generated from a live post-patch def dump; load last.
